channel.title: CIS 522 - Introduction to Data Structures :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Introduction to basic data structures such as stacks, queues, lists, and priority queues, and algorithmic techniques for sorting, searching and hashing. Emphasis on modularity and reuse. Introduction to the concept of object-oriented design and interface specifications. Credit Hours 1 credit Course Goals and Learning Outcomes TBD Course Prerequisites TBD
